description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of emotional responses, specifically representing the proportions of different emotions detected. The chart contains six slices, each representing a distinct emotional category. The slices are labeled “Neutral” (blue, 23.1%), “Anger” (yellow, 14.9%), “Sadness” (orange, 14.7%), an unlabeled category (red, 14.1%), “Happiness” (coral, 8.1%), and “Frustration” (light blue, 25.1%). Percentage labels are displayed within each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion, though this is not strictly maintained. A legend is not present, but each slice is clearly labeled with its corresponding emotion.
